snippet.title: LCD Gamer Plays - 1992 MGA PacMan Handheld
snippet.description:
LCD Gamer kicks off his channel showcasing a classic favorite - Pac-Man! This is a unique and fun version of Pac-Man that really brings you back to the 90’s. 


Gameplay - Its the Pac-Man we all know and love, with some minor changes that give us a new and interesting experience. The Level “pans” over screen by screen and doesn’t show the whole maze like in the original arcade. 

This makes the game more challenging due to the fact that you can’t see who’s on the other side of that screen...👻
However, this does allow the player to focus more on the screen he is playing at the moment.

Instagram: @Lcdgamerr

Gameplay requests? Leave them in the comments!
